default.notes: No visa for any nationality — a Visitor's Permit is issued on arrival (up to 3 months, extendable), but every traveller must obtain the EUR 10 electronic Travel Authorisation at seychelles.govtas.com before boarding.

SC.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Seychellois citizens.

XK.notes: Kosovo's recognition by Seychelles has shifted over the years — entry is normally possible on the same visa-free terms, but confirm with the nearest Seychelles representation and complete the Travel Authorisation before booking.
